class.name: OcgPrs3dPointaspect
class.brief_description: This class defines attributes for the points The points are drawn using markers, whose size does not depend on the zoom value of the views.
class.description: ! This class defines attributes for the points ! The points are drawn using markers, whose size does not depend on ! the zoom value of the views.

method.name: from_3
method.description: Defines the user defined marker point.

method.name: SetColor
method.description: defines the color to be used when drawing a point. Default value: Quantity_NOC_YELLOW

method.name: SetTypeOfMarker
method.description: defines the type of representation to be used when drawing a point. Default value: Aspect_TOM_PLUS

method.name: SetScale
method.description: defines the size of the marker used when drawing a point. Default value: 1.

method.name: DumpJson
method.description: Dumps the content of me into the stream
